currentPage.seoDescription: God gave you unique skills and talents to help change the world around you. At Life.Church, there are serving opportunities to fit your skills and schedule.
currentPage.title: Serving | Life.Church

01.headingText: Explore in-person or digital serving opportunies.

00.content: Life.Church is full of diverse people, and God made each of us to serve in different ways. Whether you attend a location or entirely online, there’s a role out there for you! And don’t worry, we offer specialized training so you can always feel confident each time you serve.

0.content: Create a welcoming environment online or in person and help everyone feel comfortable during weekly services.
Help kids birth-6th grade learn about who God is and who they are through age-specific lessons, small groups, and fun.
Help people take next steps by managing day-to-day operational needs, events, and details to celebrate people as they grow in their faith.
Serve on stage and behind the scenes to help people connect with God through weekly worship services, social media, and photography.
Be part of leading the next generation. Switch, our student ministry, addresses issues teens face through conversation, friendship, worship, and teaching in-person and online.
Help connect people to trusted relationships through LifeGroups—either online or in person—and to opportunities to love their neighbors through our Mission Partners.
Central teams provide support and resources for all Life.Church locations and ministries. When you serve with Central ministries, you’re helping equip the local and global Church.
Did you know you can serve digitally with Life.Church Online? Care for our global church family through email, live services, social media, and more.

02.headingText: Just tap the button below, fill out your information, and we’ll help with the rest.
